cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)

project(7zip-linux LANGUAGES C CXX)

# Build for the Linux-specific parts of the 7-Zip port. Upstream makefiles stay
# untouched; the upstream source lists are imported from them through
# cmake/UpstreamSources.cmake (generated by tools/upstream_sources.py).

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE RelWithDebInfo CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

set(Z7_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.." CACHE INTERNAL "")
get_filename_component(Z7_ROOT "${Z7_ROOT}" ABSOLUTE)

option(Z7_WERROR "Treat warnings in Linux port code as errors" ON)
set(Z7_SANITIZE "" CACHE STRING "Sanitizers to enable, for example address,undefined")
option(Z7_BUILD_ORACLE "Build upstream 7zz with the upstream makefile as a test oracle" ON)

list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")
include(Z7Common)
include(UpstreamSources)

enable_testing()

add_subdirectory(core)
add_subdirectory(platform)
add_subdirectory(shim)
add_subdirectory(theme)
add_subdirectory(gui)
add_subdirectory(fm)
add_subdirectory(kde)
add_subdirectory(packaging)
add_subdirectory(tools)
add_subdirectory(tests)
